limitations: Caller provides authorized retained shared node pools; persistent node-map cache, coalesced refresh, bootstrap, automatic MOVED map updates, managed asynchronous facade and replica policy remain work.
Real Cluster matrix is plaintext IPv4/default user. TLS port selection and denial policy have fixture tests; full real TLS/auth/trust matrix remains work.

COMPLETE is a terminal native outcome, not necessarily successful query. Stop snapshots are immutable; last native Future may still be pending after route stop. Failed control and uncertain delivery never authorize replay.

Create copies argument descriptors/payload once into a bounded controller allocation; a longer redirect can allocate one bounded host buffer. Native attempts copy their own wire. No zero-overhead claim.

Closed-loop local-peer depth1/32 measurements are unpinned, include caller queueing, and are not fixed-arrival/mixed-load/upstream/CPU/RSS/native Linux/72h acceptance. Heap runs include peer/mechanical tails and exclude cold setup.
